verdict.rationale: Sunbiz publishes a 'Print & Mail Form' rail with downloadable PDF Articles of Incorporation for profit and non-profit corporations. The annual-report flow also offers a 'Pay by Check' option that prints a mail-in voucher. The pack never shows the actual mailing address, fax number, or mail-in equivalents for other tasks such as LLC formation. missing for 10: published mailing address and fax number, paper forms for LLC and other filings, explicit framing of the paper path as a fallback when the online flow is down, independent corroboration.
